title: ALIGN ONCE, BENEFIT MULTILINGUALLY: ENFORCING MULTILINGUAL CONSISTENCY FOR LLM SAFETY ALIGNMENT

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating and comparing the model's safety rates, attack success rates (ASR), and cross-lingual consistency (Pair-wise Agreement) across high-resource languages (e.g., English, Chinese) and low-resource languages (e.g., Swahili, Urdu, Bengali) using multilingual safety benchmarks like PKU-SafeRLHF and MultiJail.
